budget_items.what_was_recorded: The third-quarter commitment amount was reported and the bills were printed and sent.
budget_items.quote: the commitment amount was $316, 741.96 and required a vote by the commission.

budget_items.topic: FY26 budget, Total Retained Earnings Appropriation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A formula error was corrected and the Total Retained Earnings Appropriation is now stated at a corrected figure.
budget_items.quote: the total retained earning appropriation is now $302,232.77

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A 27% delinquency rate was reported, said to be about $400K, and the Commission was told paying customers would reduce the need to take money from Retained Earnings.
budget_items.quote: they have a delinquency rate of 27%, that works out to be about $400k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission was told there is $2.1 Million in Retained Earnings, and money taken out will eventually go back in.
budget_items.quote: there currently is $2.1 million in retained earnings

budget_items.topic: Debt service owed to Leominster and Fitchburg
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The money owed for debt service is said to be less than the betterments being paid in FY26; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the money that is owed to leominster and fitchburg for debt service will be less than the betterments being paid in fy26.

budget_items.topic: Losses from Munis demand printing failure
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Losses from the inability to print demands since the Munis upgrade were reported as over $10,000.
budget_items.quote: bill commented there were over $10,000 in losses since the munis upgrade had not been able to print out demands.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A demand fee appeared in Munis when a customer paid at Town Hall, but no separate bill had been sent, so its legality is in question; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: however, the demand fee had never been sent out on a separate bill so they questioned if they can legally charge it.
